comment: Communities/districts along the Airport Run route (Norman Manley → Ocho Rios). Entries marked needs_owner_review need verification from the owner's lived knowledge — map data alone is insufficient. Coordinates are WGS-84 lat/lon; radius is in world units (scale 0.3, so radius 250 ≈ 833 m real-world). Order follows the route.

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Roundabout where the Palisadoes spit meets the mainland; gateway from the airport into Kingston

communities.name: Rockfort
communities.note: Eastern Kingston industrial area; historic fort site on the coast

communities.name: Wareika Hill
communities.note: Eastern Kingston hillside community, strongly associated with early Rastafari culture

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: Major commercial hub in central Kingston; landmark clock tower; named for the cotton tree that once stood here

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: Jamaica's former colonial capital and St. Catherine Parish capital; route uses the bypass but the sign is unmistakable

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Entrance to the Rio Cobre gorge; Flat Bridge crossing — dramatic narrow bridge over the river

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: St. Catherine market town; immortalised in the folk song 'Linstead Market'

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: Quiet hill-country crossroads in St. Ann Parish; geographic centre of the island

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: Famous hilltop roadside cookshops — jerk chicken, roast yam, festival; every Jamaican knows this stop

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: Three-kilometre tree-canopied gorge road on the descent into Ocho Rios; one of Jamaica's most iconic drives

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: Resort town on Jamaica's north coast; cruise ship capital; end of the Airport Run
